rules: Single-domain discovery retains the existing domain E-value and model-coverage thresholds.

HMMER -Z is fixed at 10000 reference target sequences so the independent E-value threshold has the same scope in small validation batches and genome/assembly runs. This standardized candidate score is not a full-assembly false-positive guarantee.
When no single domain passes coverage, each chained component must independently pass the same E-value threshold.
Chained model intervals and query intervals must both be strictly increasing and nonoverlapping; repeated copies of the same model region cannot be summed.
An inter-component query gap may exceed the corresponding model gap by at most one model length. This is an uncalibrated candidate-stage boundary, not an insertion-tolerance or activity claim.
Coverage is the sum of nonoverlapping component model intervals, never the span across uncovered model gaps.

For chains, independent_evalue stores the maximum component domain E-value, not a combined significance; domain_bitscore stores the sum of component scores. Their scopes and all component coordinates are explicit.
Discovery changes do not establish catalytic identity, full H-domain integrity, active cofactor assembly or molecular function.
